_meta.note: Curated high-confidence interaction subset for the demo. Not a complete interaction checker.

pairs.title: Warfarin + Aspirin
pairs.mechanism: Both reduce clotting ability; together they markedly increase the risk of gastrointestinal and other bleeding.
pairs.action: Contact your prescriber before taking these together. Watch for bruising, black stools, or unusual bleeding.
pairs.source: FDA warfarin labeling; NHS medicines information

pairs.title: Warfarin + Ibuprofen
pairs.mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit platelet function and irritate the stomach lining, adding to warfarin's bleeding risk.
pairs.action: Avoid combining unless your prescriber has specifically approved it. Ask about a safer pain reliever.

pairs.title: Aspirin + Ibuprofen
pairs.mechanism: Ibuprofen can interfere with aspirin's antiplatelet effect and increase stomach irritation.
pairs.action: Discuss timing and alternatives with your pharmacist.

pairs.title: Ciprofloxacin + Calcium
pairs.mechanism: Calcium can bind ciprofloxacin in the gut and reduce how much antibiotic is absorbed.
pairs.action: Separate doses by at least 2 hours; confirm timing with your pharmacist.

pairs.title: Tetracycline + Calcium
pairs.mechanism: Calcium chelates tetracycline and lowers antibiotic absorption.
pairs.action: Separate doses by at least 2 hours; confirm with your pharmacist.
